description: Retrieval evaluation set (Member 5 brief, Part F). Questions are drafted by Member 5. 'expected' lists record ids (file names in knowledge/investigations/) and must be filled in by a person reading the stable records, never from memory or an AI answer. A query is scored only when every expected id is a verified record; otherwise the runner reports it as not scorable yet.
labelStatus: Questions drafted 2026-11-14. Labels proposed 2026-11-14 by llm:claude-opus-5-5 from the 13 stable records' fields and Key Findings (each labelSource names the evidence), before any evaluation run; pending review by Member 3. q07 changed from the brief's label (see its labelSource). Holdout questions n03, q06, q09, q17 and q23 were inspected to diagnose bugs on 2026-11-14 (see holdoutNote); their holdout scores are optimistic.

kinds.specific: Hit when an expected investigation appears in the top k. With expectedSections, a section-level hit also needs that chunk type.
kinds.enumerative: A list question. Also scored for recall: share of expected investigations found anywhere in the results.
kinds.negative: No answer exists in the corpus. Pass when the response is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with no results.

cases.query: How does airflow affect flame spread over solid materials?
cases.labelSource: Records with solid fuels and airflow speed as a variable whose Key Findings report flame spread vs flow: bass, bass-ii, saffire.

cases.query: Which investigations studied material flammability?
cases.labelSource: Records whose Objective is material flammability (prevention category): bass, bass-ii, saffire, acme-bre ('materials flammability in still atmospheres').

cases.query: What did BASS-II find about flames in low-speed flow?
cases.labelSource: Named investigation; bass-ii Key Findings on low flow speeds.

cases.query: Which investigations studied smoke detection?
cases.labelSource: Member 5 brief, Part F; confirmed by the records (safetyCategories detection, smoke-detector objectives). Saffire also carries 'detection' but measured smoke rather than studying detection; not required.

cases.query: What instruments measured smoke particles?
cases.labelSource: Sensors sections: SAME and SAME-R moment instruments (P-Trak, ionization chamber, DustTrak, MPASS) measured smoke particles.

cases.query: How was smoke detection studied?
cases.labelSource: Objective: SAME and SAME-R measured smoke particle size to support spacecraft smoke-detector design.
cases.holdoutNote: Inspected on 2026-11-14 while fixing: method-question section intent. No longer an unbiased holdout; replace with a fresh question when the set is next revised.

cases.query: Which experiments studied fire suppression?
cases.labelSource: Records with safetyCategories suppression and a tested suppressant: flex (inert-gas suppressant efficacy), bass (nitrogen suppressant jet). Changed from the brief's [flex, flex-2]: the flex-2 record assigns no safety category. Saffire excluded: its Limitations say extinction was ventilation-based only, with no suppressant agent.

cases.query: What did FLEX find about flame extinction?
cases.labelSource: Named investigation; flex Key Findings on radiative and diffusive extinction.

cases.query: How were suppressants tested on burning fuel?
cases.labelSource: Conditions: bass nitrogen suppressant flow and nozzle distance; flex diluent type and amount.
cases.holdoutNote: Inspected on 2026-11-14 while fixing: method-question section intent. No longer an unbiased holdout; replace with a fresh question when the set is next revised.

cases.query: Which investigations ran in the Microgravity Science Glovebox?
cases.labelSource: Records whose hardware field lists the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG).

cases.query: Which experiments used the Combustion Integrated Rack?
cases.labelSource: Records whose hardware field lists the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR).

cases.query: What hardware did Saffire use?
cases.labelSource: Named investigation; saffire hardware field (Saffire Flow Unit, Far Field Diagnostics).

cases.query: Which investigations burned liquid fuels?
cases.labelSource: Records with fuelType liquid.

cases.query: What materials were tested in Saffire?
cases.labelSource: Named investigation; saffire material field.

cases.query: What oxygen concentrations were used in the BASS experiments?
cases.labelSource: 'The BASS experiments' covers BASS and BASS-II; both Conditions sections give oxygen.

cases.query: How does oxygen concentration change flammability in microgravity?
cases.labelSource: Key Findings on oxygen and flammability: acme-bre (self-extinguish below ~25% O2), flex (limiting oxygen index), bass-ii (oxygen flammability boundary, 1-g blowoff at 16% O2), saffire (elevated oxygen, more energetic flames).

cases.query: What happens to a flame when ventilation airflow stops?
cases.labelSource: Key Findings on flames with little or no airflow: saffire (cotton regrew with the fan off), acme-bre (burn for minutes in the absence of an air flow), bass and bass-ii (flames sustained below 1 cm/s).
cases.holdoutNote: Inspected on 2026-11-14 while fixing: compound split airflow/air flow and keyword-plus-meaning support. No longer an unbiased holdout; replace with a fresh question when the set is next revised.

cases.query: Which investigations varied the forced airflow speed?
cases.labelSource: Variables fields listing a forced airflow, flow or coflow speed: bass, bass-ii, saffire, same, same-r, slice, spice. flex-2 excluded: its flow comes from moving the droplet, not forced airflow.

cases.query: How do flames behave differently in microgravity than on Earth?
cases.labelSource: Key Findings that compare microgravity with normal gravity: slice, flex, bass-ii, saffire, same, acme-e-field, spice.

cases.query: Which experiments compared ground tests with microgravity results?
cases.labelSource: Key Findings reporting 1-g comparison tests or 1-g data beside microgravity results: bass, bass-ii, saffire, slice (Yale replica hardware), same, acme-e-field.

cases.query: What did the spacecraft-scale fire experiments show?
cases.labelSource: Saffire is the only spacecraft-scale (Cygnus) fire experiment in the records.

cases.query: What are the limitations of the Saffire results?
cases.labelSource: Named investigation; saffire Limitations section.

cases.query: Why does flame spread matter for lunar habitat design?
cases.labelSource: Fire Safety Relevance (team interpretation) sections of the flame-spread records: bass, bass-ii, saffire.
